subject: End-of-term settlement: retainer offset, PO closure, and VAT checklist
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@northbridge.com>
To: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounting@northbridge.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:24:00 -0800
Subject: Final invoice / retainer offset question for EoT settlement

Hi Irene,

Quick note as we're closing out the contract this month — finance has reviewed the final invoice draft and flagged two items before we can trigger payment:

- We need the retainer offset documented explicitly on the invoice (we had a $25k retainer from 2024 that should be applied).
- VAT evidence: EU VAT ID verification and a short summary of taxable vs. non-taxable line items so our tax team can book the credit.
- PO closure: our procurement team wants a PO-closure confirmation PDF to attach to the AP ticket.

Could you send a final statement that shows the retainer applied, the net amount due, and the VAT breakdown? If you can include a remittance schedule (ACH / wire details) and a suggested payment date range, that would help us lock the payment this week.

Thanks — Samira

Samira Khan
Head of Finance, Northbridge Analytics
accounting@northbridge.com
+44 20 7946 0112

Hi Samira — thanks for the clear list. Attaching a draft settlement statement that:

- Applies the $25,000 retainer as an immediate credit line item.
- Shows gross fees, retainer credit, VAT at 20% (per the signed SOW tax clause), and net due.
- Includes a separate VAT evidence workbook with your VAT ID validation column filled where available.
- Contains a PO closure confirmation stub you can attach to your AP ticket.

Internal note (cc'd Monica and Vivek): can you confirm the PO-closure PDF is OK from our side and whether we should apply any final discounts tied to the renewal amendment?

Samira — proposed remittance window: 7 business days from receipt of the signed settlement statement (we've put wire and ACH details on the statement). If you need Net-30, let us know and we can route for final approval.

Attachments: Redwood_Final_Settlement_Statement.pdf; VAT_Evidence_Northbridge.xlsx; PO-44321-closure-confirmation.pdf

Best,
Irene Choi

irene.choi@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800

Irene / Vivek — quick internal:

- PO close: procurement confirmed the PO number 44321 can be closed once we send the PO-closure-confirmation PDF. Monica to sign and return.
- Retainer offset: legal confirms we should apply the full $25k as credit per the original contract. No additional approvals required.
- VAT: Finance requests a single-line VAT summary in the invoice (we should call out VAT-able subscription vs. one-time professional services). Vivek, can you validate the VAT rate we used (20%) is the correct EU rate for the customer's registered country?

If all good, I'll sign the PO closure PDF and mark the invoice as ready.

Monica
Director, Revenue Operations
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Final invoice / retainer offset question for EoT settlement

Hi Samira — thanks for the patience. Confirming the VAT treatment below and next steps:

- VAT: 20% standard rate applies to the one-time professional services portion. Subscription SaaS line is zero-rated for intra-EU B2B where valid VAT ID is provided. Your VAT ID is validated in the attached workbook (VAT_Evidence_Northbridge.xlsx).
- Retainer: $25,000 credit applied as requested; net due is $47,200 after VAT and credits (see Redwood_Final_Settlement_Statement.pdf).
- PO closure: Monica will sign the PO-44321-closure-confirmation.pdf and return.
- Remittance schedule: recommended wire by 2026-12-01. If Northbridge needs Net-30, we can accept but please issue the remittance instruction and expected date so we can reconcile.

Once Monica confirms PO close (cc'd), I'll send an invoice packet to accounting@northbridge.com and upload the DocuSign link for signature.

Best regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Finance Ops, Redwood Inference
